Xabi Alonso's Chelsea Replacement

Caicedo starts in Alonso's double pivot. Which midfielder, in Chelsea's squad or anywhere in Europe's top five leagues, best completes the pair?

Xabi Alonso
Head coach · Chelsea · from 1 July 2026
The finding

Chelsea's missing piece is a deep progressive passer to play beside Caicedo.

    Who covers which job

    Distance to each pivot profile

    Each dot is a candidate midfielder. Further left means closer to Andrich's holding profile, higher means closer to Xhaka's passing profile. Caicedo and Chelsea's squad options all sit on the holder side.

    What Alonso's role needs

    Two jobs in the double pivot · percentile of per-90 values

    Alonso started two central midfielders in almost every match, and they did different jobs. The holder keeps the ball safe and wins it back. The passer moves it forward. Bars show where Andrich and Xhaka ranked among 348 Big 5 midfielders (50 = market median). Chelsea have the holder in Caicedo, but nobody does the passer's job.

    How this was built

    Method

    Data

    FBref (Opta) league stats 2022-23 to 2026-27, Transfermarkt contracts, values and lineups, and Hudl StatsBomb events for Leverkusen 2023-24. Cleaned and linked by name, birth year and club.

    The role

    Alonso's Leverkusen midfielders 2022-25 (12 player-seasons, 900+ minutes) define the role, measured with 14 per-90 metrics across passing, creating, ball security and defending.

    The fit

    Every metric is a per-90 rate (or a percentage), so players with different minutes compare fairly. Charts show each value's percentile among 348 Big 5 central and defensive midfielders; hover for the per-90 figure. Fit is the average standardised distance from a profile, so lower is closer.

    Status

    Exploratory. The final ranking comes after clustering and a cost, contract and availability review.

    Step 1 · The role

    What Alonso demands from a midfielder

    Built from the seven midfielders who played 450+ minutes in a season for Alonso's Leverkusen. Every metric is per 90 minutes (or a percentage); charts show where each per-90 value ranks among 348 Big 5 central and defensive midfielders.

    Role fingerprint

    050 = market median100

    Four of the five highest bars are about having and moving the ball. Tackles plus interceptions sits at the 48th percentile, right on the market average.

    Two jobs in the double pivot

    050100

    Alonso's two most-used midfielders did different jobs. Xhaka is the progressive passer, top 1% for progressive passes but bottom 4% for tackles plus interceptions. Andrich is the secure holder, 97th percentile for ball retention and playing deeper.

    Where Leverkusen's players sit in the market

    Standard deviations from the average
    Market spread (box = middle 50%)Leverkusen player-seasonRole average

    Right means more of the metric (for ball retention, fewer losses). Leverkusen's players cluster to the right on passing, touches and recoveries. Both Xhaka seasons sit far beyond the market's range for progressive passes.

    Two central midfielders, almost every match

    Double-pivot share by season

    Share of Alonso's matches that started exactly two central or defensive midfielders. It peaked at 98% in the unbeaten title season.

    Formations used

    174 matches

    3-4-2-1 was the base system. Every common shape uses a two-man central midfield.

    Independent check: StatsBomb event data

    Leverkusen 2023-24 · StatsBomb definitions

    StatsBomb's event data counts actions differently, so these numbers are not compared with the FBref figures above. They confirm the split: Xhaka leads on progressive passing, while Palacios and Andrich press far more often.

    Step 2 · The squad

    Who completes the double pivot with Caicedo?

    Caicedo starts as one of Alonso's two central midfielders. He already does the holding job, so his partner needs to do the other one: the deep progressive passing that Xhaka did at Leverkusen. Each option is scored on how close they are to that passer profile, using 2024-25 and 2025-26 league stats (to 12 January 2026).

    How the 14 metrics relate

    Correlation · 348 candidates

    Progressive passes, final-third passes and touches move together (0.82-0.91), as do shot-creating actions and key passes (0.91). The model will account for this overlap before the final ranking.

    Preliminary and exploratory: fit is the mean standardised distance across 14 league metrics (2024-25) from Xhaka's Leverkusen profile. It doesn't yet account for team style, league strength, injuries or transfer cost, which the next stage adds.
